articles.title: Ancient school where Aristotle taught Alexander the Great has been unearthed by archaeologists in Greece
articles.summary: In an extraordinary archaeological discovery in northern Greece, a gymnasium complex tied to Alexander the Great's education has emerged in Mieza. Believed to have been established by King Philip II, this site functioned as a prestigious institution for the elite.

articles.title: Private Effort Protects Reservoir: Landowner’s project restores creek; safeguards Kinkaid Lake water
articles.summary: Greg Reising began his conservation work on his 100-acre property near Kinkaid Lake in 1995. He transformed former agricultural land by establishing prairie vegetation and planting thousands of trees.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Ohh My Dog OTT release date: Pankaj film hits streaming platform
articles.summary: 'Oh My Dog', Pankaj Tripathi's comedy-drama directed by Amir Rai, released in theatres on August 7, 2026, and will stream on Netflix from October 1, 2026. The film follows two timelines: Appu searching for her missing dog Momo, and Prince's dog Oscar hunting for his owner.

articles.title: Anne Hathaway says her doctor advised her to stay away from spicy food
articles.summary: In a candid interview, Anne Hathaway revealed her hope to join the ranks of guests on 'Hot Ones', fueled by her movie 'Verity' that references the show. Though her doctor has recommended she steer clear of spicy dishes during her pregnancy, Hathaway's enthusiasm remains.

articles.title: Netizens say Taylor Swift is wearing Travis Kelce’s shirt in a new video
articles.summary: Taylor Swift recently shared a pre-release video for her song 'Patient Zero' on her social media. Many fans noticed that she wore a shirt similar to that of her husband, Travis Kelce.

articles.title: Allu Arjun wishes wife Sneha Reddy on her birthday with romantic selfie
articles.summary: Allu Arjun celebrated his wife Sneha Reddy's birthday with a heartfelt social media post including a selfie. The couple appeared to be on a getaway as they posed beside a stunning ocean backdrop.
